name: ghidra-psx-ldr
notes: sha256 is of the prebuilt release asset for Ghidra 12.1.4. Needs Java 21 and Ghidra 12.1.4. test.sh installs it into a throwaway user.home and imports a hand-made PS-X EXE with analyzeHeadless (-loader PsxLoader; the display name 'PSX Executables Loader' is rejected by -loader).
